changes.reason: Frozen independent in-process contract for region-owned subnet readback, empty response, unsupported options, role and instance-session refusal, and inconsistent ownership. No real cloud or VM.

DescribeSubnets reuses the existing atomic EC2 discovery transaction, IAM allow check, request-region ownership namespace, saved stack region and network row kind/owner match. Instance-only console still rejects all actions except DescribeInstances. This is the same admission/returned identity abstraction as EC2ReadDiscovery; new subnet XML projection is separately checked by the frozen native oracle.

models.limits: Finite atomic admission and identity only, not individual EC2 action names, HTTP/XML, SQL snapshots/failure semantics, bounds, tags, CIDR/state projection or Go refinement. Native contract and existing EC2Read regressions remain required; no VM readiness claim.

Independent developer-only detector tests for oracle immutability, scope and retained SQS registration.
